title: Underwriting Auction for sale of Government Securities for ₹33,000 crore on October 01, 2026
summary: Government of India has announced the sale (re-issue) of Government Securities, as detailed below, through auction to be held on October 01, 2026 (Thursday) . As per the extant scheme of underwriting commitment notified on November 14, 2007, the amounts of Minimum Underwriting Commitment (MUC) and the minimum bidding commitment under Additional Competitive Underwriting (ACU) auction, applicable to each Primary Dealer (PD), are as under: (₹ crore) Security Notified Amount MUC amount per PD Minimum bidding commitment per PD under ACU auction 6.20% GS 2029 9,000 215 215 6.57% GS 2033 12,000 286 2

direction_reasons: No clear directional signal in the available text
TMB.why_it_matters: This reaches the company indirectly via its regulation exposure to RBI, and Reserve Bank of India. The parts of the business most likely touched are revenue. Classified as tender.

ai_analysis.revenue_effect: Treasury income could fluctuate depending on the underwriting commission earned (if TMB participates as an underwriter) and subsequent movements in G-Sec yields which impact the valuation of the bank's investment portfolio.
ai_analysis.margin_effect: Unclear, but net interest margins (NIM) could face indirect pressure if the auction yields push benchmark interest rates upward, subsequently raising the bank's cost of deposits.
ai_analysis.cost_effect: No direct impact on operating costs, but could indirectly influence the bank's wholesale funding costs if sovereign yields rise post-auction.
ai_analysis.competitive_effect: Neutral, as the auction is a system-wide event affecting all Indian scheduled commercial banks and primary dealers similarly.
ai_analysis.regulatory_effect: Assists the bank in managing its Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) compliance requirements as mandated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
ai_analysis.short_term: Potential volatility in treasury gains or mark-to-market (MTM) book value immediately following the auction on October 01, 2026, depending on the bidding yields.
ai_analysis.medium_long_term: Influences the pricing of TMB's investment portfolio and helps shape the yield curve, which dictates the pricing of long-term loans and deposits.
ai_analysis.second_order_effects: Fluctuations in government bond yields can impact corporate bond spreads, affecting the valuation of TMB's non-SLR investment portfolio.
ai_analysis.key_uncertainty: The extent of TMB's direct participation in this specific underwriting auction and the final cut-off yields demanded by the market.
monitor_next: Final cut-off yields and underwriting commission rates decided in the RBI auction on October 01, 2026.
Movement in the benchmark 10-year Indian Government Bond yield post-auction.
TMB's treasury performance and MTM provisions in its subsequent quarterly financial results.
Any changes in RBI's monetary policy stance or SLR requirements.
